records.name: Pi coding agent
records.one_liner: An extensible terminal coding product with an in-process SDK, built on the small Pi loop and JSONL sessions.
used_by: OpenClaw (historical coding-agent embedding; current direct dependency is pi-tui only)

features_notes.subagents: Example extensions and host orchestration, not a built-in scheduler.
features_notes.durable_resume: JSONL session resume, not mid-tool durable execution.
features_notes.approvals: Project trust and gating hooks; approval extension examples, no built-in permission system.

dims.loop: AgentSession wraps pi-agent-core; product extensions add context, tools and UI.
dims.providers: pi-ai provider abstraction; provider and virtual-model extension APIs.
dims.tools: Four default tools: read, bash, edit, write; replaceable operations and extra tools.
dims.context: AGENTS.md, skills, prompt sections, session-tree context and compaction.
dims.state: Append-only JSONL trees support resume/fork; unfinished generation/tool work is not durably replayed.
dims.safety: Project trust and tool hooks; no built-in OS isolation or full approval policy.
dims.extensibility: Rich hook/UI/tool APIs, npm/git packages, replaceable MCP/codemode built-ins.
dims.multi_agent: Subagent and plan examples; external orchestration through SDK/RPC.
dims.surfaces: TUI, CLI, JSONL RPC and first-class TypeScript SDK.
dims.observability: Events, usage/cost and HTML session export; host supplies tracing.

key_insights: An extensible terminal coding product with an in-process SDK, built on the small Pi loop and JSONL sessions.
Append-only JSONL trees support resume/fork; unfinished generation/tool work is not durably replayed.
Project trust and tool hooks; no built-in OS isolation or full approval policy.
